treatment_records.name: Azathioprine
treatment_records.reason_stopped: Liver enzymes climbed after two years.

evidence_notes: Diagnosed seven years ago. Also has type 2 diabetes, hypertension, and osteoporosis from steroid use. Started prednisone and azathioprine combo; prednisone caused blood sugar issues requiring insulin. Azathioprine helped for two years then liver enzymes climbed. Switched to Remicade, worked for three years but developed antibodies. Currently on Humira, 50% improvement. GI wants to add methotrexate but concerned about liver. Work as accountant is difficult due to brain fog. Wife supportive but exhausted. Medical costs high. Considering clinical trials.
